learningObjective: Explain the meaning of the ONNX opset version in a model file and the compatibility contract between opset producers and consumers.

canonicalClaims.claim: The ONNX opset version identifies the schema version of each operator in a given domain; a consuming runtime must implement the exact schema of the declared opset to run the model correctly.
conditions: The model declares one or more opset_import entries.
The runtime advertises a set of supported opset versions per domain.
nonImplications: Does not imply the newest opset is always best-supported.
Does not imply opset version tracks runtime binary or exporter framework version.

misconceptions.claim: Opset version equals runtime binary version.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Runtime versions and opset numbers are independent.

misconceptions.claim: Opset changes only affect serialization layout.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Opset governs operator semantics (attributes, defaults, behaviors).

misconceptions.claim: Opset ties the model to the exporter framework version.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Opset is domain-owned; the exporter maps its ops to whatever opset is chosen.

misconceptions.claim: A runtime that supports opset N supports all N-1, N-2, ... automatically.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Runtimes may drop very old opsets; supported ranges are declared explicitly.
